description.value: Yum Yai Thai Food is an authentic Thai restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street corridor, formerly known as Bob Likes Thai Food, serving home-style Thai cuisine under the philosophy of 'we serve what we eat.' The name YumYai blends the Thai words for bold mixed flavours (yum) and big-hearted (yai), reflecting a menu that ranges from papaya salads and chicken satay to coconut curries and classic Pad Thai. Touring cyclists on the Main Street bike route will find a compact, takeout-friendly stop with vegetarian and gluten-free options across most menu categories.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates the OSM phone number (604 568 8538) and street address (3755 Main Street), but the postal code differs: OSM has V5N 3N8 while the website consistently shows V5V 3N8. The OSM tag takeaway=yes is confirmed by the website phrase 'Call us for Takeout!' The menu lists multiple items tagged 'Gluten free' and explicitly offers vegetarian/tofu substitutions, confirming dietary options; no cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, washrooms, wi-fi, water) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Yumyai Thai Food' (one word) but the website consistently renders it as 'Yum Yai Thai Food' (two words).
Postal code discrepancy: OSM records V5N 3N8, but the website shows V5V 3N8 on every page — the website value may be correct.
OSM old_name tag records a prior business name ('Bob Likes Thai Food'), indicating a recent rebrand; the current OSM check_date of 2025-10-25 suggests the record has been reviewed.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active Thai restaurant on a major Vancouver cycling corridor with confirmed takeout service and vegetarian/GF menu options — a practical food stop for touring cyclists.
